parties.respondent: The Institute Of Chartered Accountants of India & Others

summary: Regulatory competence of ICAI under Chartered Accountants Act 1949; ceiling limit on tax audit assignments; Article 19(1)(g) right to practice profession; reasonableness of restriction under Article 19(6); professional misconduct determination; numerical audit cap initially 30 raised to 60; Guidelines No.1-CA(7)/02/2008 Clause 6 challenged as violative of Articles 14 and 19(1)(g); validity of disciplinary proceedings initiated thereunder.
final_judgment: Judgment not explicitly stated in provided excerpt; case disposed of by common order but specific disposition not revealed.
